about: Admitted synthetic cases whose recorded reference, not the port, is wrong. Reports count them apart from port failures. docs/testing.md, 'Known failures', states when an entry may be added or removed. 'expected' is the exact evaluation metrics the invalid reference produces; any other result is flagged.

cases.cause: Recorded on the Linux recorder, so its #version screen prints 'Unix NetHack Version' and '/dev/urandom' where the judge's macOS recorder and the port print 'MacOS' and '/dev/random'.
Juiblex's magic mapping overflowed recorder patch 006's 6144-byte screen buffer, which overwrote nine recorded cursor positions; all 18,153 RNG calls match.
